title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Coconut Curry
description: A smoky and savory Jamaican dish featuring unsweetened coconut milk, this curry is perfect for a monsoon evening, with a grassy and crispy texture from the roasted vegetables, and a spicy kick from the scotch bonnet peppers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine the coconut milk, scotch bonnet peppers, onion, garlic, curry powder, and thyme, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, toss the carrots and potatoes with the blended curry sauce until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables out in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and stir in any accumulated juices.
Return the vegetables to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
